description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the distribution of response types—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two conditions: “Ours” and “Standard.” The vertical axis displays the two conditions, labeled “Ours” and “Standard,” in that order. The horizontal axis represents the percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, and tick labels at 10% intervals. For the “Ours” condition, the bar is composed of three segments: a blue segment labeled “Context” with a value of 60.6%, an orange segment labeled “Generated Response” with a value of 31.7%, and a green segment labeled “Other” with a value of 7.7%. For the “Standard” condition, the bar is also composed of three segments: a blue segment labeled “Context” with a value of 23.6%, an orange segment labeled “Generated Response” with a value of 51.1%, and a green segment labeled “Other” with a value of 25.3%. The segments within each bar are stacked, representing the cumulative percentage for each response type. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
